new.content: Skip to content Home > What is the salary of a Playwright automation tester in Pune? What is the salary of a Playwright automation tester in Pune? Discover the latest salary trends for Playwright Automation Testers in Pune, including experience-wise pay, top IT hubs, essential skills, and career growth opportunities. If you're planning to enter this field, Automation Testing Courses Pune can help you build industry-ready skills and improve your job prospects. Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri July 23, 2026 10:30 am Pune has quietly become one of India’s busiest hubs for software testing jobs, and Playwright has emerged as the go-to automation tool for modern QA teams. If you’re a student or a working professional wondering what this role actually pays, you’re in the right place. Many learners exploring Automation Testing Courses Pune ask the same question before enrolling: is this skill worth the investment? In this guide, we break down real salary ranges, the factors that move your pay up or down, and the skills that help you earn more—in simple, student-friendly language. Salary Range of Playwright Automation Testers in Pune The Automation Tester Salary in Pune varies widely depending on experience, company, and location within the city. On average, a Playwright automation tester in Pune can expect anywhere between ₹3.5 LPA (fresher level) to ₹15+ LPA (senior/lead level), with mid-level professionals typically earning between ₹6 LPA and ₹12 LPA. Pune’s IT ecosystem is spread across multiple hubs, and pay scales can differ slightly depending on which part of the city you work in, since different hubs host different mixes of MNCs, product companies, and service providers. Salary by Experience Level Here’s a general breakdown of how experience impacts pay for automation testers working with Playwright: Freshers (0–1 year): ₹3.5 LPA – ₹5.5 LPA—entry-level QA roles where Playwright is often learned on the job after manual testing basics. Junior/Early-career (1–3 years): ₹5 LPA – ₹8 LPA—hands-on scripting, test case automation, and basic CI/CD exposure. Mid-level (3–6 years): ₹8 LPA – ₹13 LPA — framework design, API automation, and cross-browser testing ownership. Senior/Lead (6+ years): ₹13 LPA – ₹20+ LPA—test strategy, team leadership, and architecture-level automation decisions. These are broad market ranges based on current job postings and industry salary data; actual offers depend on the specific employer, project, and negotiation. Pune IT Hubs: Hinjewadi, Baner & Wakad Hinjewadi is Pune’s largest IT park and hosts a dense concentration of global majors alongside product startups, which tends to keep compensation competitive at every experience level. Baner and Wakad, being close to Hinjewadi, host several mid-sized IT companies and delivery centers, offering roles that are similar in scope but sometimes slightly more flexible on work mode. Testers in these belts often get exposure to product-based testing environments, which can translate into faster salary growth over time. Companies with a strong presence in this belt, along with how their automation testing pay typically trends: Company Role Salary Range Infosys Automation Tester ₹4L – ₹5L TCS Automation Tester / Test Lead ₹4L – ₹9L (up to ₹20L+ senior) Wipro Automation Tester ₹4.5L – ₹6.8L Cognizant Automation Engineer ₹4.6L – ₹8.5L Capgemini Playwright Automation Tester Up to ₹12L Accenture Automation Engineer ₹5L – ₹8L Tech Mahindra Automation Tester ₹5.3L – ₹13L Persistent Systems Software Test Engineer ~₹6.45L HCLTech Automation Tester ₹4.6L – ₹9.7L IBM Automation Test Specialist ₹7.3L – ₹9L (up to ₹12.3L) Unlock the Secrets to a Powerful LinkedIn Profile ! Download Free e-Guide PCMC IT Hubs: Talawade, Bhosari, Pimpri & Chinchwad The Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC) belt—covering Talawade, Bhosari, Pimpri, and Chinchwad—has grown into a secondary IT corridor with a mix of service-based companies and captive delivery centers. Salaries here are generally comparable to Hinjewadi for equivalent experience, though the volume of purely product-engineering roles is lower. This area is a strong option for freshers and early-career testers looking for their first breakthrough into automation testing. Salary Range (Pune) Typical Role Focus Fresher (0–1 yr) ₹3.5 LPA – ₹5.5 LPA Manual + basic automation scripts Junior (1–3 yrs) ₹5 LPA – ₹8 LPA Playwright scripting, regression suites Mid-level (3–6 yrs) ₹8 LPA – ₹13 LPA Framework building, API + CI/CD integration Senior/Lead (6+ yrs) ₹13 LPA–₹20+ LPA Test architecture, team leadership Note: Figures represent broad market ranges compiled from current job listings and industry salary trends; individual offers vary by company and skillset. Factors That Affect the Salary of Playwright Automation Testers in Pune Not every automation tester with the same job title earns the same salary. Several factors influence how companies price this role, especially when it involves a modern Playwright Automation Tool skillset. Years of hands-on experience: Practical scripting experience matters more than certificates alone. Depth of Playwright expertise: Testers who can build reusable frameworks, not just write test cases, command higher pay. Programming language proficiency: Strong JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, or Python skills alongside Playwright increase your market value. CI/CD and DevOps exposure: Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI is increasingly expected, even at mid-level roles. Company type: Product-based companies and top-tier consulting firms generally pay more than smaller service providers for the same experience band. Domain knowledge: Testing experience in finance, healthcare, or e-commerce domains can add a premium. Location within Pune: As covered above, Hinjewadi and Baner-Wakad roles can sometimes edge out PCMC-based roles in product-company opportunities. Soft skills and communication: Testers who can present test strategies clearly to stakeholders often move into leadership roles faster. Major IT employers with a strong presence in Pune — including Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Capgemini, Accenture, Wipro, LTIMindtree, Tech Mahindra, and Persistent Systems — regularly hire for automation testing roles involving Playwright, Selenium, and related tools, contributing to steady, ongoing demand across experience levels. Top Skills for Higher Playwright Salaries If you want to move up the pay scale faster, certain Automation Tester Skills consistently show up in higher-paying job descriptions. Playwright fundamentals: Locators, auto-waiting, fixtures, and test parallelization. API testing: Tools like Postman and REST Assured to validate backend responses alongside UI flows. Programming depth: Writing clean, maintainable code in TypeScript or JavaScript (Python and Java are also in demand). Framework design: Building Page Object Model (POM)-based frameworks that scale across projects. BDD tools: Cucumber or similar behavior-driven development frameworks for readable test scenarios. CI/CD pipelines: Integrating automated tests into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Version control: Practical Git and GitHub/GitLab workflow experience. Cross-browser and cross-platform testing: Ensuring test coverage across Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit. SQL basics: For backend/database validation during test execution. Debugging and troubleshooting: The ability to diagnose flaky tests and optimize execution speed. Testers who combine these skills with real project experience typically negotiate salaries at the higher end of their experience band, regardless of which IT hub they work from. This shift is opening up strong long-term career paths. A typical growth path looks like this: Along the way, earning a recognized Playwright Certification can help validate your skills to recruiters, especially if you’re transitioning from manual testing or a different automation tool. Certifications aren’t mandatory, but they do help your profile stand out in a competitive applicant pool, particularly for product-based companies. Beyond vertical growth, many testers branch into specialized areas such as performance testing, security testing, or DevOps-focused automation roles, all of which tend to pay a premium over standard functional testing positions. With Pune’s IT corridors continuing to expand across Hinjewadi, Baner-Wakad, and the PCMC belt, the overall hiring pipeline for skilled automation testers looks set to stay healthy over the next several years. For students starting out, choosing the right learning path matters. Conclusion Pune’s automation testing job market is only getting stronger, and Playwright has become one of the clearest ways to stand out in it. Whether you’re just starting out or moving up from manual testing, pay bands across Hinjewadi, Baner-Wakad, and the PCMC belt show real room to grow, both in salary and career direction. FAQs 1. What is the average salary of a Playwright automation tester in Pune? On average, Playwright automation testers in Pune earn between ₹5 LPA and ₹12 LPA, depending on experience. Freshers typically start around ₹3.5–5.5 LPA, while experienced professionals with strong frameworks and CI/CD skills can earn ₹13 LPA or more at senior levels. 2. Is Playwright in demand for automation testing jobs in Pune? Yes, Playwright’s demand has grown significantly as companies move away from older tools toward faster, more stable automation frameworks. Pune’s IT hubs, including Hinjewadi and the PCMC belt, regularly list Playwright-focused openings across service and product-based companies. 3. Do freshers need prior experience to get a Playwright automation testing job? Not necessarily, but a solid foundation in manual testing concepts, basic programming, and hands-on Playwright projects significantly improves hiring chances. Many freshers build this foundation through Automation Testing Courses in Pune with Placement that include practical, project-based learning and direct connections to hiring companies. 4. Which Pune locations pay better for automation testers? Hinjewadi, Baner, and Wakad tend to have a slightly higher concentration of product-based companies, which can offer marginally better pay for equivalent experience. However, the PCMC belt (Talawade, Bhosari, Pimpri, Chinchwad) offers comparable opportunities, especially for early-career testers. 5. Does a Playwright certification increase salary potential? A Playwright certification alone won’t guarantee a salary jump, but it strengthens your resume and signals commitment to recruiters. Combined with real project experience and strong scripting skills, it can help you negotiate better offers, particularly when switching jobs.
